title: Opus 4.1
summary: Claude Opus 4.1 is now available in Conductor!
html:
Claude Opus 4.1 is now available in Conductor!

Improvements

  • Added drag and drop to reorder repositories in the left sidebar
  • Added PyCharm as an "Open In IDE" option
  • Conductor now remembers where you last cloned a repo and defaults to that location for new clones. Also, the initial default path is now ~/conductor.

Fixes

  • Fixed a bug where the "Add Repository" popover was not visible on some screens

Misc

  • Improved error message when failing to authenticate with gh
  • Added the full URL that was fetched to the top of the WebFetch tool call
markdown: Claude Opus 4.1 is now available in Conductor! ## Improvements - Added drag and drop to reorder repositories in the left sidebar - Added PyCharm as an "Open In IDE" option - Conductor now remembers where you last cloned a repo and defaults to that location for new clones. Also, the initial default path is now `~/conductor`. ## Fixes - Fixed a bug where the "Add Repository" popover was not visible on some screens ## Misc - Improved error message when failing to authenticate with `gh` - Added the full URL that was fetched to the top of the WebFetch tool call
